we present a general theoretical framework for proving the efficiency of incremental learners, and we show how this framework can be applied to two existing model-based learning algorithms, RMAX (an anytime learner) and MBIE (a batch learner), resulting in two new incremental algorithms, RTDP-IE and RTDP-RMAX.

RTDP-RMAX is an incremental, model-based learning algorithm that is a computationally efficient learner for MDPs with a small number of states and actions and that RTDP-IE is an incremental, computationally efficient learner that performs well on MDPs with many states and actions.
